place_fields.micro_region: Chandravalli valley / west of Chitradurga Fort
place_fields.summary: Chandravalli is an archaeological site near Chitradurga with evidence of ancient settlement, including material from the Iron Age and Satavahana period. The surrounding valley contains caves, temples and other archaeological remains.

planning_attributes.description: Archaeological site and cave landscape west of Chitradurga, known for prehistoric and historic remains.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Excavations at Chandravalli uncovered remains and artifacts associated with multiple periods, including the Iron Age and Satavahana period; Roman and Chinese coins have also been reported.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Chandravalli is about 3 km from Chitradurga; local taxi or auto can be used from Chitradurga.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The cave areas contain dark and uneven passages; visitors should use appropriate footwear and lighting and take care on steps and rocky surfaces.

place_fields.vibe: historic temple within a fortified hill complex
place_fields.summary: The Gopala Krishna temple is one of the historic temples within the upper fort of Chitradurga. The fort contains numerous temples dating from different periods, and the Gopala Krishna shrine is associated with an inscription dating the idol to the early 14th century.

planning_attributes.description: Historic Gopala Krishna temple located within the upper fort complex at Chitradurga.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Chitradurga Fort contains eighteen temples in its upper fort; the Gopala Krishna temple is among the named temples and an inscription associated with its idol dates it to the early 14th century.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Chitradurga and enter the fort complex; the upper fort involves climbing through the historic fortifications.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Exploring the fort requires climbing and uneven walking; morning is more comfortable for visiting the hill fort.

place_fields.vibe: ancient temple within a historic hill fort
place_fields.summary: Hidambeswara Temple is an ancient temple within Chitradurga Fort and is one of the best-known shrines in the fort complex. The temple is associated with the Hidimba legend and is located in the upper fort among the historic temples and granite hills.

planning_attributes.description: Ancient Hidambeswara temple within the Chitradurga Fort complex.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Local tradition connects the temple with Hidimba and Bhima from the Mahabharata; the fort sources identify Hidambeswara as one of the oldest and most notable temples in the fort.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Chitradurga Fort and continue through the upper fort; the fort requires climbing and walking across uneven historic surfaces.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The fort requires climbing and is not disabled-friendly; take care on steps and uneven stone surfaces.
